exact_span.selection: Unique actual PROCESS_BEGIN/PROCESS_END for the saved policy_nonce; all intervening physical LF-delimited raw bytes, from RECORD_BEGIN through VERDICT inclusive. No line/content filtering or raw rewriting; trailing CR handling is only the frozen decoder policy.

Configuration control_pages2 and translation_queries4 describe the control-protection helper’s two-pass pages, not the three private backings.

Zero busy/halted/call_pending/first_error/effect_count/effect_pending/ever_resources fields are coherent bounded metadata snapshots. This report does not independently observe reference counts, actual memory bytes, backing physical ownership, DMA or hardware retirement.

CRCRLF_parser_caveat: The actual record lines use CRCRLF. Frozen audit003 uses bytes.splitlines(keepends=True), which splits bare CR into extra entries; an initial author extraction using that pattern failed exact BEGIN. The untouched physical-LF span independently presented to the already-frozen decoder decodes under its explicit trailing-CR normalization. This is only a record interpretation, not a workaround whole-grade, auditor fix or regrade.
